name: angular-ssr
description: Guides AI coding assistants to correctly set up Angular SSR, diagnose NG05xx hydration errors, and apply SSR patterns in Angular v17+ applications.

interface.shortDescription: Setup, diagnose, and fix Angular SSR and hydration errors
interface.longDescription: Guides any AI coding assistant through correct Angular SSR setup, NG05xx hydration error diagnosis with root-cause tracing, and SSR pattern usage. Covers provideClientHydration, Transfer State, incremental hydration, engine selection, and a full anti-pattern blacklist. Targets Angular v17+ with built-in @angular/ssr.
